==Biography==
On October 21, 2014 it was announced that NoName had decided to leave LMQ along with ackerman and Vasilii, and that negotiations were ongoing with Mor.<ref>http://www.ongamers.com/articles/lmq-announces-departure-of-vasilii-ackerman-noname/1100-2279/</ref> On November 24, NoName announced his retirement.<ref>[http://p.t.qq.com/longweibo/index.php?lid=15957390907649614150 NoName's retirement statement (Chinese)] ''p.t.qq.com'' [https://twitter.com/LMQNoName/status/537534940502425602 English] ''twitter.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Played professional DoTA before he started playing League.
* He moved to [[Royal Club Tian Ci]] from [[LGD Gaming]] with transfer fee ¥60,000 {{Abbr|CNY|Chinese Yuan Renminbi}} in March 2013.<ref>[http://games.qq.com/a/20130311/000217.htm LOL首次交易正规化 无名6万身价加盟皇族]''games.qq.com''</ref>
* He has been the team captain of every single team he has competed with.
